Architectural Coverage Score (ACS = share of gold-standard required files read or edited); First Correct Tool Call (FCTC, steps to first required file); MCP calls per trial (tool adoption); Veto Protocol events
Automatic: harness/calculate_acs.py parses Claude Code JSONL transcripts (Read, Edit, Write, Bash paths) against manually verified gold-standard file lists

Criterion: ACS (and completion = ACS >= 1.0). All with Claude Code + claude-sonnet-4-5, headless (claude -p). Quality verdict on navigational coverage only (no correctness tests); no cost verdict (cost not measured)
- Vanilla Claude Code + Sonnet 4.5 (n=89): ACS G1 90.0±20.3%, G2 79.7±20.6%, G3 76.2±23.6%, overall 82.0±22.1%; completion 54%; FCTC 1.67. Partly
- BM25-prepended + Claude Code + Sonnet 4.5 (n=81): G1 100.0±0.0%, G2 85.1±17.7%, G3 78.2±22.9%, overall 87.1±19.4%; completion 62%; FCTC 1.36. Works (G1), partly (G2, G3)
- CodeCompass graph + Claude Code + Sonnet 4.5 (n=88): G1 88.9±21.2%, G2 76.4±19.7%, G3 99.4±3.6%, overall 88.3±18.6%; completion 66%; FCTC 1.93 (G3 2.23 vs Vanilla 1.31). Works (G3), partly (G1, G2). Tool adoption 42.0% overall (G1 22.2%, G2 0%, G3 100%); ACS 99.5% when used vs 80.2% when ignored
- Prompt variant (CodeCompass, initial vs checklist-at-END prompt, G3 only): adoption 85.7% -> 100%, G3 ACS 96.6% -> 99.4%

Tasks: 30 tasks on FastAPI RealWorld app, G1 semantic / G2 structural / G3 hidden. Configurations: A Vanilla, B BM25 top-10 prepended, C CodeCompass MCP. Baseline: A. Held constant: Claude Code, claude-sonnet-4-5, clean git checkout per trial, built-in tools. Not constant: prompt (C has extra tool instruction; G3 C prompt changed mid-study to checklist-at-END). Acceptance criterion: manually verified gold-standard file lists (no tests). Repetitions: 3 runs per task-condition (258/270 completed; 12 lost to API credit exhaustion). Human intervention: none (--dangerously-skip-permissions)

G3: CodeCompass 99.4% vs Vanilla 76.2% (+23.2 pp) and BM25 78.2%; Welch t-test C vs A t=5.23, C vs B t=4.83, both p<0.001. G1: BM25 best (100%). G2: CodeCompass worst (76.4% vs 79.7% and 85.1%), attributed to zero tool adoption plus prompt overhead. Overall completion C 66% > B 62% > A 54%; BM25 fastest FCTC. Significance only tested for G3

Distinguished conditions on G1 and G3; taxonomy claimed to have predictive validity. Repeatability: 3 runs, but G3 condition C prompt changed between runs. Limitations stated: single codebase; ACS is not correctness; prompt sensitivity (improvement partly reflects prompt design); single model

Single Python codebase; ACS measures navigation not correctness; prompt sensitivity, tool call should be structurally enforced (tool_choice or planning agent); only claude-sonnet-4-5; graph unvalidated by experts, needs SME validation and maintenance; tool adoption is an open research problem

Inconsistencies: discussion says tool-ignore rate 61% and adoption 38% vs 58.0%/42.0% in results; Vanilla G3 '80% ACS' (p. 13) vs 76.2%; '20 pp' vs 23.2 pp; G3 C SD ±3.6% (table) vs ±3.5% and ±7.7% (text). Values used from result tables (pp. 10-11). G3 condition C mixes an improved prompt introduced after initial trials (30/35 adoption -> 31/31). Duplicate result directories from concurrent runners; most recent kept. Paper appears unfinished (references 'to be populated', Appendix A 'to be attached'). Code, tasks, harness and 258 transcripts at github.com/tpaip607/research-codecompass. Pre-registration: Not stated. Language: Python
